description: Temporal feedback advected by a divergence-free curl-noise field whose three octaves are driven by their own FFT bins — the previous field used raw noise directly as a velocity, which has non-zero divergence and blooms the feedback out. Clicks emit bounded wipe fronts that punch fresh video through the accumulation. History uses exact textureLoad.
name: Liquid Time Warp

updatedParams.description: Advection distance per frame; bass adds up to +50%.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Drift rate of the curl-noise octaves.

updatedParams.name: Scale
updatedParams.description: Base spatial frequency of the flow field.

updatedParams.name: Decay
